desc:
Welcome to Judge Anime! ⚖️

Step into the courtroom and decide the fate of your favorite anime characters!

How to Play:

⚖️ Judge Anime Characters: Make the right calls and prove your wisdom!
🏙️ Build Your District: Place judged characters into your territory.
💸 Collect Cash: Earn money from the characters in your zone.
🔄 Rebirth: Use your riches to Rebirth and multiply your earnings!
🔓 Unlock Characters: Reach new Rebirth levels to discover rare characters.

👍 Like the game and join our group for updates!
